fields.name: aspect_ratio
fields.title: Aspect Ratio
fields.description: Output aspect ratio, or adaptive selection.

fields.name: duration
fields.title: Duration
fields.description: Output duration in seconds. Set to null for smart duration, which lets the model pick a length from the prompt and reference media.

fields.name: enable_prompt_expansion
fields.title: Enable Prompt Expansion
fields.description: Enable intelligent prompt rewriting. Disabling it can save roughly 20-60 seconds of latency but is likely to degrade generation quality.
